name: ratified decisions (ADR index)
description: The Weave OS corpus is repo-versioned YAML compiled at build behind one resolver seam; governance is git + CODEOWNERS + each file's evolution_policy; the Pattern Registry splits into a repo rulebook and Postgres records — open ADR-0020 before changing.

content: Diagnostics from the corpus's cross-file validator are REPORTED, never thrown: validateCorpus returns CorpusDiagnostic[] and resolveWeaveOs neither consults nor fails on them. The corpus ships with seven errors the designer owns, so refusing to resolve would trade a visible named problem for an unusable package. Malformed files are the opposite — compileCorpus throws ValidationError naming the path and field, so a bad file fails the build. The rule: a broken FILE is fatal, a broken RELATIONSHIP between files is a diagnostic.

name: Weave OS runtime architecture (Figma)
description: The designer's Weave OS RUNTIME architecture lives in Figma file xXo4CDHx0PxbgEPuyPJx4Z ('Resonance 9-21-26'), page 'Weave OS Architecture' (2580:57143). It is a stage-machine runtime design (InteractionRouter -> SessionManager -> Stage.py {StageExecutor, StageUpdater, DataExtractor, StageEvaluator} -> DefinitionLoader -> WeaveContextUpdater {ConversationContext/CreatorContext/WeavePresence resolvers, ContextAssembler} -> ConversationRuntime -> ModelProvider -> ConversationResultHandler -> InterfaceRenderer -> Frontend), plus Chat.py, Capabilities.py, SessionStore, DataGate and a four-database data layer (Frequency, Creator, EvaluationMetrics, Relationship). Its vocabulary does not appear in the five docs/Weave*.md the corpus was transcribed from; only the 'WeaveOS definitions' box maps onto packages/weave-os. Row at y=10472 (InterviewTrigger 3278:20869, ConversationGeneration 3274:24493, ContinuousConversationGeneration 3284:40253, ChatTrigger 3280:38667, ContinuousChat 3284:40094, StageRendering 3278:21887) was declared complete design on 2026-09-21; field-level contracts are in the 'DatatContract Library' frame 3029:13977. Read it with a hierarchy-aware figma_execute outline; flat text extraction loses which card a tag belongs to.

title: Figma Weave OS Architecture wins over the July docs; Python labels mean TypeScript
rationale: Decided by Jared on 2026-09-21 after the parity audit. The Figma page 'Weave OS Architecture' (file xXo4CDHx0PxbgEPuyPJx4Z) is the most recent design and takes precedence wherever it disagrees with docs/Weave*.md or DEFECTS.md. Every module the Figma labels .py or .sql is to be implemented in TypeScript inside this monorepo, not as a Python service. The reconciliation iteration covers creator onboarding (emerging-creator interview) and creator profile generation only. Anchor seed: resonance-4200 (epic) with children resonance-3b51 (ADR-0021), resonance-8c94 (contracts), resonance-bed3 (designer list), resonance-9699 (land intent branch), resonance-87f7 (/feature build), resonance-f983 (Figma implementation page), resonance-226f (close pl-9c75). Consequence: ADR-0020's premise that the five docs are the design input is superseded for anything the Figma restates; ADR-0020 s2 (machinery not executed) will be reversed by ADR-0021.
